tools.name: get_token_risk_score
tools.description: Free basic risk score for a Solana token: 0-100 score, A-F grade (or IC for allowlisted issuer-controlled assets), verdict, risk flag codes, and whether on-chain metadata is mutable (informational; not scored). Free, no payment needed.

tools.name: get_token_risk_report
tools.description: Rugsight full risk report for a Solana SPL / Token-2022 token: mint & freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions, top-20 holder breakdown (wallets vs pools/programs/burn), liquidity, main-pool LP burn/lock status (burnedPct, lockedPct, unlockAt), 24h volume, pool age, a launch-bundle / sniper heuristic
